newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hicor buys two firms, cautions shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Hicor buys two firms, cautions shareholders.

text.p: Hicor Ltd said on Friday it had bought Hi-Fi Specialists Ltd and that its subsidiary, Hicor Trading Ltd, had bought Audiolens (Cape) Ltd for a combined consideration of 10.44 million rand.
At the same time Hicor urged its shareholders and those of Allwear Ltd to exercise caution in their share dealings as talks on the restructuring of the two companies were still in progress.
It said details would be released as soon as a decision had been taken.

Hicor said, subject to the realisation by Hi-Fi of certain pre-tax profits for its four financial periods ending March 31, 1999, the purchase price of Hi-Fi would amount to 3.85 million rand effective March 1, 1996 to be settled by the issue of 5.5 million Hicor shares at 70 cents per share.
It said 40 percent of the price or 1.54 million rand would be settled by the immediate issue of 2.2 million Hicor shares at 70 cents per share.

Of the remaining 3.3 million shares, that number of Hicor shares as is equal to the pre-tax profit of Hi-Fi for every financial year ending March 31 divided by 70 cents would be issued to vendors after the determination of the period's profit.

If the total 5.5 million shares had not been issued after the financial year of Hi-Fi ending March 31, 1999, the purchase price would be reduced to the extent that the pre-tax profit had not been realised at that stage.

Hicor said the 6.59 million rand payment for Audiolens would be settled through a payment of 4.74 million rand in cash and the balance through the issue to Audiolens of 2.31 million Hicor shares at 80 cents each.
Hicor said the acquisitions were important to its expansion into the consumer electronics and photography sectors.
